titulo: O menor versículo da Bíblia: Jesus chorou
estilo_imagem: cinematic photorealistic epic film still, dramatic volumetric god rays, floating dust particles, deep chiaroscuro, first century Judea, muted earthy tones, vertical 9:16
prefixo_video: Cinematic epic film shot, slow and subtle motion.
epoca_imagem: Ancient Bethany village near Jerusalem, 1st century AD, limestone houses, rock-cut tombs, olive trees, clay, wood and linen only, nothing modern

cenas.trecho: O menor versículo da Bíblia tem só duas palavras: Jesus chorou.
cenas.prompt_imagem: extreme close-up of a single drop of water falling onto the fine dust of ancient limestone ground in front of a sealed rock-cut tomb, a strong beam of golden light
cenas.prompt_movimento: the drop falls in slow motion and dust lifts softly in the beam of light, very slow camera push-in

cenas.trecho: Em Betânia, perto de Jerusalém, Lázaro estava no sepulcro havia quatro dias.
cenas.prompt_imagem: wide aerial view of a small first century Judean village of limestone houses on a hillside, olive groves, Jerusalem far away on the horizon, golden haze
cenas.prompt_movimento: slow aerial camera glide forward over the village, haze drifts, olive leaves sway in the wind

cenas.trecho: Muitos judeus tinham vindo consolar as irmãs dele, Marta e Maria.
cenas.prompt_imagem: high view of the stone courtyard of a first century Judean house at dusk, clay oil lamps along the walls, tiny figures far away in the distance gathered in mourning
cenas.prompt_movimento: the oil lamp flames flicker, smoke drifts slowly upward, slow camera descent

cenas.trecho: Maria caiu aos pés de Jesus: Senhor, se estivesses aqui, meu irmão não teria morrido.
cenas.prompt_imagem: close-up of two hands resting palms down on the dusty stone road outside an ancient Judean village, the hem of a linen garment, low golden light
cenas.prompt_movimento: fine dust drifts across the road in the light, the linen hem moves gently in the breeze, static camera

cenas.trecho: Vendo-a chorar, Jesus comoveu-se profundamente e perguntou: Onde o colocaram?
cenas.prompt_imagem: a dusty path winding between olive trees toward a limestone hillside with rock-cut tombs, late afternoon light, long shadows
cenas.prompt_movimento: olive leaves tremble in the wind, long shadows stretch slowly, slow camera push-in along the path

cenas.trecho: Responderam: Vem e vê, Senhor. E ali, diante do sepulcro, Jesus chorou.
cenas.prompt_imagem: an ancient rock-cut cave tomb sealed by a large stone, olive trees around, a tiny distant figure standing before it, soft rays of light through dust
cenas.prompt_movimento: rays of light shimmer through floating dust, olive leaves sway gently, very slow camera push-in

cenas.trecho: Os judeus comentaram: Vejam como ele o amava!
cenas.prompt_imagem: wide high view of a limestone hillside with a sealed rock-cut tomb, tiny figures far away in the distance gathered at its entrance, golden evening light
cenas.prompt_movimento: golden light shifts slowly across the hillside, dust drifts in the air, slow camera pull-back

cenas.trecho: Ele ordenou: Tirem a pedra. Marta avisou: Senhor, ele já cheira mal.
cenas.prompt_imagem: close-up of a huge stone at the dark entrance of a rock-cut tomb, cracks in the limestone, a beam of light falling across the stone
cenas.prompt_movimento: dust trickles down the rock face, the beam of light slowly widens, slow camera push-in

cenas.trecho: Jesus olhou para cima: Pai, eu te agradeço porque me ouviste.
cenas.prompt_imagem: view looking up from a Judean hillside to a vast evening sky, clouds parting with bright heavenly rays, olive branches at the edges of the frame
cenas.prompt_movimento: clouds drift apart slowly and the heavenly rays grow brighter, olive leaves sway, slow camera tilt up

cenas.trecho: Então gritou: Lázaro, venha para fora! E o morto saiu, envolto em faixas de linho.
cenas.prompt_imagem: the open entrance of an ancient rock-cut tomb with the great stone rolled aside, strips of white linen at the threshold, brilliant light pouring out of the darkness
cenas.prompt_movimento: brilliant light pours slowly out of the tomb, dust sparkles in the air, the linen strips stir in the breeze, slow camera push-in

cenas.trecho: Tirem as faixas dele e deixem-no ir. João, capítulo onze.
cenas.prompt_imagem: loose strips of white linen lying on the dusty ground before an open rock-cut tomb, warm golden sunlight, olive trees
cenas.prompt_movimento: the linen strips flutter gently in the wind, golden light glows warmer, slow camera pull-back

cenas.trecho: Ele sabia o final e mesmo assim chorou. Sua dor importa: Jesus chorou.
cenas.prompt_imagem: the empty open rock-cut tomb on a Judean hillside at sunrise, the great stone rolled aside, warm god rays and dust in the air
cenas.prompt_movimento: the sunrise light grows slowly, dust floats in the god rays, slow camera pull-back

legenda:
Jesus, obrigado por chorar comigo 🙏💧
João 11:32-44
Comente "Amém" se você sabe que sua dor importa para Jesus.
